Title: Sign in with email and password

Steps (Step): Enter the test email and password and tap Sign in
Steps (Expected Result): Home screen loads with the user's name

Steps (Step): Enter the test email with a wrong password and tap Sign in
Steps (Expected Result): An error says the details are wrong and no session starts

Title: Reset password email
Steps (Step): Tap "Forgot password" and enter the test email
Steps (Expected Result): A reset email arrives within 2 minutes

Title: Remember me keeps you signed in
Steps (Step): Sign in with "Remember me" ticked, close the browser, reopen the site
